text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Teehee! No matter how many times I see
it, I never fail to be charmed by my cute
little beauty
mark. It really accentuates
my face!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: If having one already makes me this alluring, then adding more might possibly make me even more charming...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh... This isn't what I had imagined at
all! Wait...
It's not coming off! Don't tell
me this is a
permanent marker?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl covers her face with
makeup in an attempt to conceal the
pen marks on her face, but she's so
self-conscious about her appearance 
that she can't concentrate for the rest of
the day.
